text: AI agents are autonomous software entities that execute specific tasks on behalf of their users, combining computational engineering with cognitive simulation; this stipulated definition anchors the paper's monitoring analysis.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
